Analysts remain collectively bullish on the industrial stock, with 17 rating AVAV a Buy and three rating the defense tech specialist a Hold. The average 12-month target price is $225.77, implied upside of more than 55% from recent levels.

Stifel analyst Jonathan Siegmann reiterated his Buy rating and his $220 12-month target price after AeroVironment announced the award of a $465 million contract from the U.S. Army under the Enduring-High Energy Laser (E-HEL) program on September 2. [...] ### Monday (9/7)
